title: Auto Loans: loan balance and fees due behind a same-day payoff figure
content:
# Auto Loans: loan balance and fees due behind a same-day payoff figure

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower asks to pay an auto loan off today by a transfer from their own PCB checking account. It fixes the loan balance and the fees due on which the payoff figure rests. Here **Principal** means the loan's unpaid balance of the amount financed, and a payment's **Principal Portion** is the part of it applied to that balance.

## Entry condition for the fees due

Every returned payment fee that followed an autopay debit presented to a closed source account has been waived before the payoff amount is fixed. Where that does not yet hold, the payoff amount is not fixed.

## Clauses

1. **Principal** is recomputed from the loan's ledger as the disbursement amount, less the Principal Portion of every payment on the loan, plus the amount of every payment reversal, rounded to the cent.
2. **Fees due** are recomputed from the loan's ledger as all fee amounts, less all fee settlement amounts, less all fee waiver amounts, rounded to the cent.

Because fee waivers are taken off, a fee waived before the payoff amount is fixed lowers the fees due, and so lowers the payoff amount, by the fee waived.

## Ledger worked case (hypothetical)

| Ledger item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Disbursement | 31500.00 |
| Principal Portions of all payments | 19244.10 |
| Payment reversals | 402.55 |
| Fees assessed (all kinds) | 93.08 |
| Fee settlements | 25.00 |
| Fee waivers | 43.08 |

- Principal: 31500.00 less 19244.10 plus 402.55, that is 12658.45.
- Fees due: 93.08 less 25.00 less 43.08, that is 25.00.

## Points of judgement

**A fee was waived this morning; is it still in the fees due?** No. Every fee waiver on the ledger is taken off.

**A payment was returned last month; does its Principal Portion still reduce Principal?** No. The payment reversal's amount is added back.
